title: Manuel Perez and King Oliver
summary: He worked with Perez for months and admired his tone; he was too young to hear King Oliver.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah, I really did. Did you ever hear any of those real old time players like, um, Samuel Perez? Yeah, I worked with man.

I worked with man at Temple Roof Court for about six or seven months. Yeah, he was a man up there. What's one of the style of he called? Oh, he was mostly a business trumpet player. But he had his own style of jazz. He was very loud, wonderful tone, you know. Professional trumpet player. Oh, boy. He's the best I've ever been around here.

What about King Oliver? Do you remember?
